searchText: is anyone here aware if there is an EVM implementation of bn128 ecrecover? ECRECOVER is only for ECDSA signatures. BN128/254/256 is attractive due to BLS signatures ah whoops. got confused. ecrecover precompile is for secp256k1.. my corrected question would be: is anyone aware of an EVM implementation that corresponds to the ecrecover precompile? Since all clients use libsecp256k1 I'm pretty sure they just call libsecp256k1 underneath but maybe py_ecc has a generic one.
